14 / Guides

Get ready for your project.

Guide

What affects the cost of van graphics?

Panel count, vehicle size, artwork preparation, film type and fitting time are the main variables. Supply-only and fitted packages serve different needs.

Read the guide ↗
Guide

Partial wrap vs full wrap

A partial wrap covers agreed panels and can make the original paint part of the design. A full wrap changes the appearance of most exterior body panels.

Read the guide ↗
Guide

Vehicle wrap vs paint

Wrap film changes the appearance of a sound surface and can carry printed branding. Paint is a bodywork finish and may be the better option where the underlying finish needs repair.

Read the guide ↗

Before you book

Good to know.

How much do vehicle graphics cost?

Signwriting packages start from £149 fitted. Partial and full wraps are quoted per vehicle, because size, coverage, artwork and film all change the price. Send your make and model, or use the Van Designer, for a quote.

How long does it take?

Simple lettering is often fitted in a day. Partial and full wraps take longer, depending on the vehicle and whether old graphics need removing. We confirm timings with your quote.

Can you put graphics on a leased van?

Yes. Quality vinyl removes cleanly from sound factory paint, which is why it suits leased vehicles. Check your lease terms and tell us when the van is due back.

Will vinyl damage my paint?

Not on sound factory paint. Vinyl can lift poor-quality resprays or damaged paint, so send photos of any repairs and we will check before fitting.

How long does a wrap last?

A quality cast vinyl with laminate lasts several years with good care. We give you aftercare advice for the film we fit.

Can you help design my graphics?

Yes. Our team designs from your brief or works with your existing branding. You can also start with the free Van Designer and we will refine it.

Where are vehicle graphics fitted?

At our workshop on Vulcan Road North, Norwich NR6 6AQ. Call 01603 407786 to book a fitting appointment.

Can you do a whole fleet?

Yes. We create one master design, adapt it to each make and model, and fit in batches so the fleet keeps working.

What areas do you cover?

We work with businesses across Norfolk and the Waveney valley, from King’s Lynn to Lowestoft. Fitting is at our Norwich workshop.
